title: When the Cellar Falls
author: Gideon Thornbury
blurb: August Ishikawa, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
